posts.body_html: Updated =D Its getting bigger

Some new pics of S. leucophylla RED southern Baldwin Co, AL, pics taken 10/6/19. I've also added some pics of this exact clone grown in the field, the original division was acquired from private property with permission. Yes, the original mother plant is still there in the field, I was only allowed to acquire plants that could be divided

Even in a field of 100's of 1000's of leucophylla clones, this plant stood out from the rest! Outdoors here in Northern California, this plant colors up year after year, but the traps definitely need to age a bit before getting optimal coloration:
